idempotencyGuarantees: Same source history -> identical metrics output (except generatedAt and sourceCommit)
Stable top-level key order in serialized JSON
Numeric precision: ma60/stdDev60/zScore rounded to 4 decimal places
Records sorted ascending by date matching source
Window slides by exactly 1 source record per output record
nextAllowedStep: M-27 will activate the frontend display, reading from data/market-pricing-metrics.json and showing the Market Pricing Temperature widget. M-27 may apply a display cap on z-score (for example [-3, +3]) at the frontend layer; the raw values in metrics.json remain uncapped.
